signal: SearchStax made the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500, launched Smart Answers GenAI for site search, and partnered with Acquia.

email.body1:
Johnny, saw SearchStax landed on the Deloitte Fast 500 and launched Smart Answers for site search.

Growth like that usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for SearchStax off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Johnny, quick follow-up for SearchStax.

Fast 500 pace means pipeline expectations outrun what headcount can absorb, and the Acquia partnership adds a whole new account set. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings SearchStax needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Johnny, last bit of proof for SearchStax.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how SearchStax's reply rate likely compares to peer growth-stage software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Johnny, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Growing at Fast 500 pace is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to SearchStax either way.
